What did the Rigveda know about power, desire, and ambition that modern India forgot?
In this video, we explore how ancient India transformed the warrior energy of Indra, the dragon-slaying god of the Rigveda into something entirely different. While other Indo-European cultures kept their heroes killing serpents, India chose to tame them. Kaliya dances under Krishna's feet. Shesha becomes Vishnu's bed. Vasuki turns into a rope for churning the ocean.
It was a conscious choice to value harmony over conquest, acceptance over ambition. But did this beautiful transformation come at a cost?
